content:
Eric Trump has given a curious response to a ProPublica report claiming that Russian oligarch Umar Kremlev paid for part of his older brother Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding celebrations in the Bahamas in May.

In that report, a spokesperson for Trump Jr. described Kremlev — who has close ties to Russian President Vladimir Putin — as "Don's personal friend" and stressed that "he is not a person who does business with Don."

Trump Jr.'s new wife, Bettina Trump, posted on Instagram on Monday, describing Kremlev as a "dear friend" of the couple and saying he "very generously hosted two incredible celebratory nights" after their wedding.

She wrote: "This was an extraordinarily generous wedding gift from a friend, which we were tremendously grateful for at the time and remain grateful for to this day."

Kremlev's own press team said he had maintained a "friendly relationship" with Trump Jr. since they first met "about two years ago."

Eric Trump, however, apparently has no idea who this person is.

A spokesperson for the Trump family scion told ProPublica: "Eric has no idea who this person is and has never heard of him."

Meanwhile, a Trump Organization spokesperson told The Daily Beast: "Eric is neither his friend nor does he know who this person is. He felt honored to be invited to his brother's wedding."
